q.line: I don't wanna be the owner of your fantasy
stanza: Christmas Eve with your mother and sis
Don't wanna fight but your mother insists
Dog's white teeth slice right through my fist
Drive to the ER and they put me on risk
Grocery store list, now you get pissed
Unchecked calls and messages
I don't wanna be the owner of your fantasy
I just wanna be a part of your family

partner.line: I just wanna be a part of your family

q.line: Between what's flesh and what's fantasy
stanza: Outside, the street's on fire in a real death waltz
Between what's flesh and what's fantasy
And the poets down here don't write nothing at all
They just stand back and let it all be
And in the quick of the night
They reach for their moment and try to make an honest stand
But they wind up wounded, not even dead
Tonight in Jungleland

partner.line: They reach for their moment and try to make an honest stand

stanza: Gonna drive to Atlanta
And live out this fantasy
Running around with the ragtop down
Yeah, I wanna do right, but not right now
In my platforms I hit the floor
Fell face down, didn’t help my brain out
Then the baby came before I found
The magic, how to keep her happy
I never was the fantasy
Of what you want or wanted me to be

partner.line: The magic, how to keep her happy
